title: Expose durable CICS sessions and original terminal compatibility
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of terminal_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: Authenticated public routes launch CC00, fetch protocol-neutral screens, submit AID and named fields, resume after restart, and disconnect through one durable CICS session authority.
All 17 pinned base BMS maps and 441 named fields install durably. Protocol-neutral JSON and bounded TN3270 Write/WCC, SBA, field, cursor, and AID records operate on the same screen and input state.

Per-session principal ownership and CSRF hashes fail closed for anonymous, cross-principal, missing-token, and wrong-token requests. Protected and secret BMS values are not accepted or emitted by the TN3270 adapter.
Malformed JSON and TN3270 records, configured session/run capacity, idle timeout, disconnect, and restart behavior are explicit; idle sessions retain zero CPU workers.
